paragraphs: The Sprinter 313–319 CDI (NCV3 generation, 2006–2018) uses two different diesel engines, depending on the specification. The lower-output models (313, 315, 316) use the OM651 — a 2.1-litre four-cylinder diesel shared across the wider Mercedes commercial range of that era. The higher-output models (318, 319) use the OM642 — a 3.0-litre V6 diesel, also found in other Mercedes commercial and passenger vehicles. Both engines have well-documented wear patterns, which is why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SPRINTER 313–319 CDI on the road.

cards.body: A 2.1-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Sprinter 313–316 CDI from 2006 to 2018. Known for injector seal leaks and timing chain wear — see the callout above. We replace worn timing chain components, injector seals, EGR valves and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Sprinter 318–319 CDI from 2006 to 2018. Known for swirl flap and injector wear over time — see the callout above. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals, timing chain components and gaskets as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the Sprinter 313–319 CDI spans two distinct engines across the NCV3 generation, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an OM651 part will work on an OM642 van — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Sprinter quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
